source_text: Penile cancer remains rare (about 1 in 100,000 in developed countries) but occurs three to twenty-two times more often in uncircumcised men, linked to chronic inflammation, poor hygiene, and persistent oncogenic human papillomavirus under the foreskin, according to meta-analyses. [4] [106]
